failureMessage: Learning Suggestions Foundation (developer.task.learning-suggestions-foundation) native local agent iteration sınırına ulaştı.

diagnosis.summary: local_agent_iteration_limit happened because the mutation budget was spent on rejected re-inspection after a destructive partial candidate: AgentLearningQueue.swift replaced AgentLearningQueueStore/AgentLearningJob with an incompatible stub, so build broke and Phase-1 approval-gate wiring never landed.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Build-breaking queue rewrite: ALLOW-scoped AgentLearningQueue.swift no longer defines AgentLearningQueueStore / AgentLearningJobState / the call-site job shape; Engine/Inspector/TrainingLab still call the old API, so any candidate is uncompilable until the store is restored and only then extended with userApproved.
evidence: AgentEngine constructs AgentLearningQueueStore() and calls recoverInterruptedJobs, enqueue(gaps:sourceGoal:into:), nextQueued(from:), materializeBrief(for:), and mutates job.state/.lastStatus/.updatedAt/.branch/.worktree; AgentTrainingLab likewise uses AgentLearningQueueStore().enqueue(...)/nextQueued(from:) plus evidenceCount/sourceGoals.
Workspace AgentLearningQueue.swift now only defines struct AgentLearningQueue + AgentLearningJob.status/JobStatus and a scalar enqueue(...); grep finds zero AgentLearningQueueStore definitions.
AgentInspectorState filters !$0.state.isTerminal and AgentEngine maps statuses onto AgentLearningJobState — symbols absent from the rewritten queue file.
Mentor/developer-log-tail.txt: first candidate build failed; repair agents (2×) also hit iteration_limit after targeting SuggestionStore/Engine without restoring the missing store type.

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Process failure: after implementation_required / target_verified, the native agent kept read_file/search_codebase (grace then budget) instead of finishing a minimal compile-safe patch set, so no trustworthy candidate closed the gap.
evidence: Mentor/developer-log-tail.txt: repeated local_agent_implementation_required + local_agent_iteration_grace for inspection tools through step 14/14, then local_agent_iteration_limit.
Same inspection-thrash pattern repeats on Candidate build repair tours 1–2 (grace exhausted, no successful repair mutation).
Task reason already notes a prior 14-iteration read/search burn with no mutation; runtime hints are empty (budget exhaustion, not a thrown provider error).

rootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic Phase-1 gap remains open even ignoring the rewrite: gap-completion still auto-enqueues and may start workers; AgentEngine has no learningSuggestions/accept|defer|suppress; suggestion store is type-wrong and unwired; pbxproj/self-test missing.
evidence: Two AgentEngine capability-gap completion sites still call learningQueueStore.enqueue(...) then startNextLearningJobIfNeeded() (~2045–2067 and ~3777–3791).
No AgentEngine symbols for learningSuggestions, acceptLearningSuggestion, deferLearningSuggestion, suppressLearningSuggestion, or AgentLearningSuggestionStore.

AgentLearningSuggestionStore.observe(gaps: [CapabilityGap]) references a non-existent CapabilityGap and gap.id/name/provenanceID; real gaps are CapabilityGapResolution (capabilityID, kind: CapabilityGapKind, learningPath: CapabilityLearningPath?).
observe lacks deferred→proposed after ≥2 new occurrences; suppressed permanence is only implicit.
project.pbxproj lists AgentLearningStore/Queue but not AgentLearningSuggestionStore; Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs is absent while verification.command requires it.

recommendedNextSteps: Restore the original AgentLearningQueueStore + AgentLearningJob (+ AgentLearningJobState, shortID, learningPath?, sourceGoals/evidenceCount, recoverInterruptedJobs, materializeBrief, enqueue(gaps:into:)) from call-site contract; do not keep the rewritten AgentLearningQueue stub.
Then surgically add backward-compatible userApproved: Bool? = nil (decode nil→false), enqueue(..., userApproved: Bool = false), and gate nextQueued on state==.queued && (userApproved == true).

Retarget AgentLearningSuggestionStore.observe to [CapabilityGapResolution], compact metadata only, no raw-content fields; upsert by capabilityID; deferred reopen after ≥2 new occurrences; never auto-unsuppress; add file to project.pbxproj.

In AgentEngine, replace both gap-completion enqueue+start chains with suggestionStore.observe → @Published learningSuggestions; add acceptLearningSuggestion/deferLearningSuggestion/suppressLearningSuggestion (accept enqueues userApproved=true with generic source label, then may startNextLearningJobIfNeeded; defer/suppress do not start workers).
On readyForReview/completed, mark matching suggestion approved/completed; failed jobs must not auto-retry unapproved work.
Add Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs then run it, build-check.command, and git_diff; prefer replace_text mutations over further broad inspection.
testsRequired: node Scripts/learning-suggestion-policy-self-test.mjs exits 0 with learning_suggestion_policy_self_test_ok, auto_learning_gate=manual, raw_content_persistence=forbidden

Static/source asserts: nextQueued requires userApproved==true (nil/false excluded); gap-completion paths call observe and do not auto-enqueue; accept path enqueues userApproved=true and may start; defer/suppress do not start
Assert AgentLearningQueueStore still compiles against AgentEngine/AgentTrainingLab/AgentInspectorState call sites
warnings: Prior Mentor/cursor-architect-latest.json is stale relative to disk: it assumed an intact queue API and Engine learningSuggestions wiring; current failure is dominated by the destroyed AgentLearningQueueStore surface.
Do not invent a second queue type; restore then extend. Overwriting AgentLearningQueue.swift again will keep build/repair loops failing.
Do not mutate DENY paths (sidebar/UI is Phase 2) or existing system/physical approval chains.
Do not persist raw user prompts into suggestion memory; accept must use a generic provenance/source label.
CapabilityGap is not a project type — wire CapabilityGapResolution only.
